tagline: Agent World comes to Linux, in beta.
subtitle: An AppImage and a deb for x64, plus versioned looks, a todo board that sorts itself and calmer Playbook screens.

cards.title: An AppImage and a deb for x64
cards.text: Ubuntu 24.04 and similar, with the app's own git inside. The app tells you when a newer version exists. macOS stays the tested platform.

cards.title: Looks as numbered versions
cards.text: Every look you keep is a numbered version, listed in Settings, Looks, to compare and switch back to.

cards.title: A todo board that sorts itself
cards.text: A small model decides which messages become tasks and which task a follow-up belongs to. Labels, subtasks in the right place, and Tidy.

cards.title: Calmer Playbook screens
cards.text: Skills, MCP servers and Tools in Playbook and tools are quieter and easier to read.

also: A click anywhere in a diagram box picks it
Plan gate buttons stay whole in small windows
A run keeps its run bar until it ends
footer: Linux is a beta. Try it and tell us what breaks.
